summary: JD.com filed a Form 6-K announcing its annual general meeting (AGM) to be held on June 29, 2026, as an open forum for shareholders with no proposals submitted for approval. This is a routine shareholder meeting notice, equivalent to a proxy statement under US standards. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or management change is disclosed. The filing includes a safe harbor statement but no deal terms or structural changes. As a routine current report with no event triggering a special situation, it does not qualify for classification beyond 'None'.
